```{r}
PlantGrowth

       mapping=aes(y=weight,x=group)) +
```

```{r}
flights |>
  arrange(desc(month))
```
```{r}
flights |> 
  filter(arr_delay > 120 & dep_delay ==0) |> arrange(desc(arr_delay))
```
```{r}
i<-flights |> 
  filter(arr_delay >120 & dep_delay ==0) |> 
  arrange(dep_delay)

j<-flights |> 
  arrange(dep_delay) |> 
  filter(arr_delay > 120 & dep_delay <= 0)
all(i == j)
```


```{r}
library(nycflights13)
flights <-nycflights13::flights
glimpse(flights)
```
```{r}
flights |> 
  # distance is miles, time is minutes
  # covert to miles/hour using *60
  mutate(speed=distance/air_time*60) |> 
  head()
```
``` {r}
flights |> 
  mutate(speed=distance/air_time*60,
         .after=distance) |> 
  glimpse()
```
```{r}
flights |> 
  mutate(speed=distance/air_time*60,
         .after=distance) |> 
  select(year,month,day,
         dep_time,air_time,distance,speed)
```
```{r}
flights |> 
  group_by(month,day) |> 
  count()
```
```{r}
flights_grounded<-flights |> 
  group_by(month)
flights_grounded |> 
  count()
flights_grouped |> 
  ungroup()
```
# ICMA sep 17 2026
```{r}
flights |> 
  group_by(month) |> 
  slice_max(dep_delay,n=2)
```
```{r}
flights |> 
group_by(month) |> 
  summarise(mean_delay=mean(arr_delay,na.rm=TRUE),
            sd_delay=sd(arr_delay,na.rm=TRUE),
            total_dep_delay=sum(dep_delay>0,na.rm=TRUE))

```
```{r}
flights |> 
group_by(month) |> 
  summarise(mean_delay=mean(arr_delay,na.rm=TRUE),
            sd_delay=sd(arr_delay,na.rm=TRUE),
            number_late=sum(arr_delay>0,na.rm=TRUE),
            total_number=n()) |> # pipe the result of...
  mutate(percentage=number_late/total_number) |> 
# want to add mutate? - which percentage of the total flight were late
# 
ggplot(aes(y=percentage,x=month))+
  geom_line()+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=1:12)+
  ylim(0,0.55)
```

```{r}
library(nycflights13)
summary <- flights |>
  group_by (tailnum
  ) |> 
  summarize(
DELAY = mean(arr_delay, na.rm = TRUE), n=n())
```

```{r}
delay_summary <- flights |> 
  group_by(tailnum) |> 
  summarize(mean_delay = mean(arr_delay, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_flights = n())
```
